name: St. Patrick's Day
description: St. Patrick's Day word search puzzles keep an adult, calm tone — shamrock, clover, Celtic, bagpipe, blessing, coast and green-hill English — without cartoon leprechaun brands. Free online; easy, medium, hard and large print. No timer, no account and no licensed characters. Written for seniors and grown-up puzzlers who want a March seasonal theme that stays gentle. Neighbors include Spring, Mother's Day and Weather. Start with large print if you need bigger letters, or read how to play if this is your first Words at Rest grid.
